prompt: Vitrine editorial hero for the museum site: the page h1 beside one real artwork it fetches itself, on a wall tinted by that artwork.
shortDesc: Big editorial hero that renders the PAGE H1 beside ONE REAL ARTWORK it fetches itself (never pass an image). Use it first in <main> on / (<g-feature-hero intro="…"><g-search-box></g-search-box></g-feature-hero>), /highlights (no source), /highlights/<theme> (theme="the sea": the decoded URL segment as-is) and /collections/<collection id> (collection="met-11" or collection="aic-PC-10"). Choose the source with at most ONE attribute: none (museum highlights), theme, collection, or artwork-id="aic-27992". heading and kicker are optional: without them it shows a fitting h1 and kicker from the data (for a collection its real name and 'Collection · The Met'), so don't guess names. Slot a g-search-box and/or g-theme-chips inside. It shares one request with a g-artwork-grid of the same source on the page (limit, pick, layout and texts don't affect sharing); its featured work may also appear in that grid, which is intended. It is the page's only h1: don't add a level="1" g-page-section, and never use it on /artwork/<id>, /artist/<name> or /exhibitions/<id> (those page components render their own h1). artwork-id is for featuring one chosen work on an editorial page such as / or a highlights page.

props.name: heading
props.description: Big heading (the page h1). Defaults: 'Highlights of the collections', the theme in sentence case ('The sea'), the collection's real name, or the artwork title. Only write it when you have a better editorial title; never guess a collection name.

props.name: kicker
props.description: Small-caps line above the heading. Defaults: 'Highlights' ('Search results' when a theme fell back to search results), 'Collection · <museum>', or the artwork's museum. kicker="" hides it.

props.name: intro
props.description: One or two sentences of plain text under the heading.

props.name: theme
props.description: Feature a themed highlight: the decoded /highlights/<theme> segment, e.g. "impressionism" or "the sea". A theme with no highlights falls back to search results for it, and its default kicker becomes 'Search results'.

props.name: collection
props.description: Feature a work from this collection: the id from /collections/<id>, e.g. met-11 or aic-PC-10.

props.name: artwork-id
props.description: Feature this exact work on an editorial page (/ or a highlights page), e.g. aic-27992 or met-436535. Never on /artwork/<id>, where g-artwork-view renders the h1.

props.name: pick
props.description: first (default) or daily (rotates once a day through the fetched works).

props.name: tone
props.description: dark (default: a night wall tinted by the artwork) or light (a pale tinted wall).

styling.tailwindClasses: block w-full min-h-[min(76vh,700px)] grid md:grid-cols-[5fr_7fr] gap-7 md:gap-12 max-w-[1240px] mx-auto px-4 py-7 md:px-8 md:py-12
styling.notes: Full-bleed band whose background is --art-tint: the loaded artwork drawn into a 12x12 canvas, averaged, saturation clamped to 0.25 and lightness pinned to 0.14 (dark) or 0.93 (light); falls back to --night / --wall, with a 400ms colour transition. Text column (5fr, vertically centred): a gilt hairline plus kicker (a pale rose on dark, oxblood on light), h1 in Newsreader 500 clamp(40px,6vw,64px)/1.05 with text-wrap balance (italic only when it is the artwork title), intro in Newsreader 19px in the soft ink, then the slot 28px below. Artwork column (7fr): one link to /artwork/<id> around a figure: the uncropped image (object-fit contain, drop shadow, eager + fetchpriority high, with a srcset adding largeImageUrl (1686w) when the artwork source provides it, fading in over 250ms) in a fixed-height stage (min(62vh,620px); clamp(240px,50vh,480px) on phones, where it stacks above the text), then a wall-label figcaption: a short gilt rule, italic 17px title, 'Artist, date · Museum' in 12px. Hover/focus underlines the title and lifts the image 2px. Text is --night-ink on dark, --ink on light; the focus ring is oxblood on light and oxblood-tint on dark. Loading: a mat-tinted 4:5 frame pulsing in the stage, caption bars, and a two-line text skeleton in the h1 when its text comes from the data. Error or no usable work: a text-only band that still carries the h1 (error adds a short note with a link to /highlights or /collections); never a fallback picture. A failed image becomes the typographic placeholder. Sets --search-label on the band so a slotted g-search-box stays legible on dark. Reduced motion turns off pulses, fades, lifts and the tint transition.

interactions.trigger: mount with artwork-id (valid aic-/met- id only)
interactions.bodyShape: READS.artwork(id) from the shared DATA block (GetArtwork); reads payload(res,'title') as the work
READS.collection(id) (GetDepartment, limit 24); reads artworks, name, museum
READS.highlights(theme) (GetHighlights, limit 12); if it fails or has no work with an /__art imageUrl, falls back to READS.search(theme) → POST /search/<theme> (SearchArtworks, museum both, limit 24)
